thread:
sam: Quick check — PR #14233 includes the users.schema migration and a backfill. We should avoid landing into the deploy blackout Thu 00:00-04:00 UTC. Can we gate this until CI is green + infra/db review? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: Noted. CI is currently red on macos-integration (flaky). I tried a full rerun but it still failed. @ci-bot can we rerun just the failing job? :eyes:
ci-bot: ci-bot: Rerun queued by @maria. Attempt 2/3. macos-integration: running. linux-x86: passed.
kevin: I can pick up the infra/db review but there's a rebase conflict with the migration branch. @sam can you rebase onto main? small helper:```
./scripts/rebase.sh --onto main PR-14233
git push --force
```
sam: On it, rebasing now. FYI this PR adds a new column + backfill. Ops asked that the actual backfill run during the scheduled maintenance window (Wed 22:00 UTC). So we should avoid merging during the freeze and coordinate with ops.
lee: Given the Thu blackout, can we aim to land Wed before 22:00 UTC? Who can own canary monitoring after landing? @andrew? :thinking_face:
andrew: I can watch canary Wed 22:30-23:30 UTC. If CI is green and ops confirms staging backfill, I can promote and rollforward.
ci-bot: ci-bot: macos-integration completed — flaky test `test_login_timeout` failed (historical flake ~0.2%). Recommend rerunning that specific job. Use: `ci-bot rerun job macos-integration/test_login_timeout`
maria: Rerunning that job now. If it passes, @kevin please finish review and add approval.
ci-bot: ci-bot: job rerun started (macos-integration/test_login_timeout). Attempt 1.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — maintenance blackout Thu 00:00-04:00 UTC. Auto-merge disabled during blackout.
ci-bot: ci-bot: job succeeded. All checks green.
kevin: Reviewed — left one minor comment about creating the index after the backfill to avoid lock contention. @sam can you reorder the migration and push? otherwise infra is good to go :shipit:
sam: Thanks, fixed the migration ordering and pushed a new commit. Ran the migration locally against a snapshot and it completed.
kevin: Approval added. @merge-bot please hold auto-merge until ops confirms DB backfill window. If CI stays green and ops gives thumbs up, please schedule merge for Wed 20:00 UTC and run canary after backfill.
merge-bot: merge-bot: Received approval from @kevin. Auto-merge requires one clean CI run post-approval. Auto-merge will remain disabled during the blackout window. Scheduling hold as requested.
sam: Thanks all — I'm adding a note to the release board and pinging ops. @ops-team can you confirm the Wed 22:00 UTC backfill slot for staging+prod?
ops-team: ops-team: Confirmed Wed 22:00 UTC for staging backfill, prod pending final signoff. If prod is confirmed, we can proceed with the canary at 22:30 UTC and full rollout after verification.
sam: Perfect — we'll wait for prod signoff and then land earlier Wed to avoid the Thu blackout. I'll post another update when ops confirms. :thumbsup:
